en.headline: MTR offers half-price fares on Thank You Day today
en.dek: Passengers using Octopus or QR codes on the MTR, Light Rail and selected buses receive a 50 per cent discount on every fare-paying trip on 24 October.
body: The MTR Corporation is offering half-price fares across much of its network today under its Thank You Day promotion. Passengers using an Octopus card or JoyYou Card on the MTR, Light Rail and MTR Bus services in the northwest New Territories, or QR code tickets on the heavy rail network, receive a 50 per cent discount on every eligible fare-paying trip.

The discount also covers cross-boundary journeys to and from Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau stations on the East Rail Line. Octopus users can combine the half-price offer with interchange discounts, Fare Saver discounts, the 25 per cent discount on connecting journeys under the Monthly Pass, and the government’s HK$2 concession scheme for the elderly and eligible persons with disabilities.

The promotion does not apply to the First Class premium on the East Rail Line, the Airport Express, MTR Feeder Bus, High Speed Rail, single-journey tickets or contactless bank cards. The MTR said it had arranged the day under the Service Performance Rebate mechanism of its fare adjustment arrangements and would deploy additional staff at stations.

zh.headline: 港鐵感謝日今推行車費半價優惠
zh.dek: 乘客今日以八達通或二維碼乘搭港鐵、輕鐵及指定巴士，每程付費車程可享半價優惠，包括東鐵綫過境車程。
body: 港鐵公司今日（24日）推出「感謝日」車費半價優惠。乘客使用八達通或樂悠咗乘搭港鐵重鐵、輕鐵及行走新界西北路綫的港鐵巴士，或以二維碼乘搭重鐵網絡車程，均可自動享有每程50%車費扣減。
是次優惠涵蓋東鐵綫來往羅湖站及落馬洲站的過境車程。八達通用戶可同時享用轉乘優惠、特惠站優惠、全月通連接車程75折，以及政府長者及合資格殘疾人士二元優惠計劃。
優惠不適用於東鐵綫頭等額外費、機場快綫、港鐵接駁巴士、高鐵香港段，以及以單程票或感應式信用卡或扣賬卡付費的車程。港鐵表示，是次安排依據票價調整機制下的服務表現回贈機制，並已在車站加派人手協助乘客。
